title: Ranger Equipment Token Master
description: Ranger Equipment Token Master — The Townstons wiki
html:
Ranger Equipment Token Master in Townston

The Ranger Master in the north section of Townston offers players a chance to trade Kings Coins for yellow items in their class. Each item is randomly drawn from a category a player chooses. The categories available are Ranger Rings, Ranger Amulets, Ranger armor, Shoulder armor, Two-handed Ranger Weapon which is always a ranged missile weapon, Ranger gloves and Ranger boots. The price varies based on which type of armor you select, but it's never more than 6 coins.

There is a small chance that she will give purple items instead of yellow. Items sold are immediately soulbound to the buyer.
